about: Test vectors of the sync change protocol (collection/syncops.py, docs/SYNC-PLAN.md §3). Apply the ops of a case in ANY order (each op possibly twice): view and sum must be exactly these. sum = sha256 hex of the view as JSON with sorted keys and no spaces (UTF-8, not ASCII-escaped). clock/ops/diffs/compact/snap: the other functions step by step (fake wall clock from T0).

lists.explode: wish[] / have[] / custom[] -> one entry per list

decks.explode: decks[] (web: one deck per document) -> one entry per deck

deckcards.explode: decks[].cards[] (web: the deck document's cards[]) -> one per row

friendfolders.explode: the folder list as one entry

listalarms.explode: list_alarms[] -> one entry per list alarm

devices.file: sync meta (each device its own entry)

cases.name: different_fields
cases.about: two devices change different fields of one entry: both stay

cases.name: same_field_tie
cases.about: same field, same ms and counter: the device id decides (bbbb > aaaa)

cases.name: delete_vs_add
cases.about: A deletes (saw 1), B adds 1 at the same time: 1 left

cases.name: card_is_one_field
cases.about: a binder pocket's card + language + foil change together: the later op wins whole

cases.name: later_clock_wins
cases.about: delete vs change: the later clock wins (b1 back, b2 gone)

cases.name: no_half_entry
cases.about: a change on a key whose create never came stays invisible

diffs.about: a changed field and a field set to null
counted: create with count, delta, delete with the count seen
group: foil only -> the whole card

weg_a.name: max_fetched
weg_a.about: a board's fetched cursor: the larger value wins even against a later write

weg_a.name: max_read
weg_a.about: a message read on one device stays read everywhere

weg_a.name: purge_delete
weg_a.about: a deleted offer keeps no values; B's older change arriving after the delete stays out

weg_a.name: purge_newer_change
weg_a.about: a change newer than the delete brings the entry back – with only its own values
